title: [v18] flow text slots: read ADR-0032 §3's `{{ }}` delimiter instead of single-brace `{token}` (notify title/message and the other flow string slots), converting only what renders the same
body:
Governing text: ADR-0032 (Accepted) Decision 3, "**One delimiter, `{{ }}`; single `{ }` deleted.**" (`docs/adr/0032-unified-expression-layer.md:78`).

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim. This executes an accepted ADR; it is not a decision card. Under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` 〈升级与决策〉, the protocol is the baseline: code that disagrees with it is aligned to it, and an option that conflicts with the governing text is not a decision card. Amending §3 instead is the maintainer's to ask for, on its own card.

## What disagrees today (read on `main` `aa71c4d9d1`)

- Two template delimiters ship side by side:
  - `{{ }}`: the formula template engine (`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts:31`, `HOLE_RE`) and the messaging renderer (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-renderer.ts:40`).
  - `{ }`: flow node text slots. The flow interpolator reads single-brace tokens (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/template.ts:359`). The notify node's `title` / `message` say so (`builtin/notify-node.ts:190`). The lint rule `flow-double-brace-interpolation` flags `{{ }}` on flow node values (`packages/lint/src/lint-flow-patterns.ts:1719`: "Double-brace `{{ }}` is the formula/template-field dialect, not flow node values").
- The spec already types these slots: since PR #22063, a notify node's `title` / `message` are `template`-typed slots (objectstack-ai/objectstack#22081). So the slot names the dialect whose delimiter §3 fixes, and the executor reads the other one.
- Authors follow the shipped spelling. `git grep -c` (a pattern count, not a parse):
  - hotcrm `main`: 69 single-brace `{record.…}` tokens in 12 `*.flow.ts` files, and 0 `{{`;
  - this repo's examples: 46 in 2 files, and 0 `{{`.
- The cost §3 names is live. `{ }` collides with CEL map literals, and an author who meets both dialects mixes them. objectstack-ai/objectstack#22081 is that mix: a refusal prescribed `{{record.name}}` for a slot whose lint flags it.

## Scope

- Flow node **text** slots: notify `title` / `message`, and every other flow string slot the single-brace interpolator reads. Enumerate them first.
- ⛔ Not the value slots. `fields.*` and assignment values leave the template dialect for CEL on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939 (maintainer ruling D on #11182).
- ⛔ Not `titleFormat`: it is deprecated toward `nameField` (ADR-0079).

## Measure first

1. Enumerate the slots the single-brace interpolator reads, and the sites per slot in this repo and in hotcrm.
2. Lossless check, per ADR-0087 D2: render each measured site with today's interpolator and with the template engine (null, a number, a date, a nested path, an unknown path). Only spellings that render the same may convert automatically.

## Direction

- The text slots read `{{ }}` through the formula template engine (§3: holes are paths plus whitelisted formatters).
- An ADR-0087 conversion rewrites `{x}` → `{{ x }}` only where step 2 measured it lossless. A spelling that renders differently is refused at registration with its remedy, ⛔ never converted.
- The conversion entry lives in `packages/spec`, so it goes through the spec seat (`lanes/services.md:11`).
- `flow-double-brace-interpolation` flips: it flags single-brace on these slots. The notify-node description and #22081's refusal text prescribe `{{ }}`.

## Pins

- A notify title `Hello {{ record.name }}` renders the name.
- A stored `Hello {record.name}` loads converted (when lossless) and renders the same text.
- Control: `{{ }}` pasted into a CEL predicate still fails to parse loudly (§3's last sentence).

## Sequencing

- Serial with objectstack-ai/objectstack#19939: both edit the flow interpolation module (`builtin/template.ts`). Claim after it lands, or declare the overlap.
- Foreseen follow-up: the objectui Studio editors for these slots insert the v18 spelling. Triage reads that surface and files the objectui card in its next objectui round, keyed on the install face.

`Clause-②: yes`: a published authoring contract changes on the v18 line.

Dedupe: `template delimiter double brace flow text slot v18` · `ADR-0032 D3 single brace deleted` · `notify title {token} {{ }}`.
